shared_elements: possible small human figure beside the animal
justification: Both surfaces appear to depict a large humped, long-necked quadruped in strict profile occupying most of the field, and in each case there may be a smaller anthropomorphic form adjacent to it, which is a reasonably specific correspondence. But A is a fully naturalistic, modelled relief with anatomical detail, a bridled camel led by a costumed attendant holding a lead, framed above and below by continuous rosette bands, whereas B is a bare, schematic outline animal on an unframed surface with no clear attendant, harness or ornamental border.
